purpose: Provenance for the unedited SightReader App captures used by the bilingual WERD product pages.
imagePolicy: Each currently used source asset is a byte-for-byte copy of its release-evidence original; source screenshots may be JPEG or PNG. The website displays the matching locale's source image in a separate flattened lossless WebP mockup using the Apple iPad Pro 13-inch (M5) bezel; the screenshot is mapped 1:1 into the configured screen opening and the original capture is not cropped or edited. Device and output provenance is in ../device-mockups/provenance.json. The standalone Apple frame file is not published.
